parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).
